title: Cleavage Agent Name
description: Enzyme or chemical agent used to cleave molecules, such as proteins, during sample preparation.

title: Molecule
description: Type of molecule or molecular material present in the sample.

title: Sample State
description: Physical state of the sample or material, such as solution or solid.

title: Staining
description: Staining procedure or method applied to the sample.

title: Extraction Buffer
description: Buffer or chemical solution used during extraction of the target material.

title: pH
description: Measure of the acidity or alkalinity of the sample or experimental solution.

title: Sample Pre-Fractionation
description: Separation or fractionation procedure applied to the sample before subsequent analysis.

title: Protein Column
description: Chromatographic column used for protein separation or fractionation.
